# Support

Before opening an issue, please check the following resources:

## Documentation

- **Getting Started**: [docs/71-getting-started.md](docs/71-getting-started.md)
- **FAQ**: [docs/README.md](docs/README.md#faq)
- **Known Limitations**: [docs/future/known-limitations.md](docs/future/known-limitations.md)

## Community Help

- **GitHub Discussions**: [github.com/imageforge/imageforge/discussions](https://github.com/imageforge/imageforge/discussions)
  - Best for: Questions, ideas, general discussion
  - Response time: 1-3 days

## Bug Reports

If you've found a bug, please check [existing issues](https://github.com/imageforge/imageforge/issues) before filing:

1. Search existing issues
2. If no match found, file a [Bug Report](https://github.com/imageforge/imageforge/issues/new?template=bug-report.md)
3. Include steps to reproduce and your browser/OS version

## Security Vulnerabilities

**Do not open a public GitHub issue for security vulnerabilities.**

Report security issues privately via:

- Email: security@imageforge.dev
- GitHub Security Advisories: [Report a vulnerability](https://github.com/imageforge/imageforge/security/advisories/new)

## Feature Requests

Have an idea? Check the [roadmap](docs/12-roadmap.md) first, then file a [Feature Request](https://github.com/imageforge/imageforge/issues/new?template=feature-request.md).

## Response Times

We're a small open-source team. Please be patient:

| Channel                  | Expected Response        |
| ------------------------ | ------------------------ |
| Security vulnerabilities | Within 48 hours          |
| Bug reports              | Within 3-5 business days |
| Feature requests         | Within 1-2 weeks         |
| Discussions              | Community-driven         |

---

Thank you for using ImageForge! 🎨
